description: This file provides high-level functions for interacting with DataFlash memory modules, including initialization, printing info, reading, writing, and erasing DataFlash devices. It defines structures, global variables, and functions to manage multiple DataFlash chips via SPI communication.

methods.name: int AT91F_DataflashInit(void)
methods.description: Initializes DataFlash devices by probing connected chips via SPI and populating the dataflash_info array with device parameters based on probe results.

methods.name: void AT91F_DataflashPrintInfo(void)
methods.description: Prints information about each connected DataFlash device, including type, number of pages, page size, total size, and logical address.

methods.name: AT91PS_DataFlash AT91F_DataflashSelect(AT91PS_DataFlash pFlash,unsigned int * addr)
methods.description: Selects a specific DataFlash device based on address and returns a pointer to its descriptor for subsequent read/write/erase operations.

methods.name: int read_dataflash(unsigned long addr,unsigned long size,char * result)
methods.description: Reads data from DataFlash memory at specified address and size, returning the result in a buffer.

methods.name: int write_dataflash(unsigned long addr_dest,unsigned int addr_src,unsigned int size)
methods.description: Writes data to DataFlash memory at specified destination address from a source buffer.

methods.name: int erase_dataflash(unsigned long addr_dest)
methods.description: Erases an entire DataFlash device starting at the specified address.

ctags.name: read_dataflash
ctags.pattern: /^int read_dataflash(unsigned long addr, unsigned long size, char *result)$/

ctags.name: write_dataflash
ctags.pattern: /^int write_dataflash(unsigned long addr_dest, unsigned int addr_src,$/
ctags.signature: (unsigned long addr_dest,unsigned int addr_src,unsigned int size)
